title: Welcome to MuStefkoff!
body:
The gates are open. Register an account on this website, download the client, and join the fun.

Experience rate: 999x | Master experience: 888x | Max level: 400 + 400 master.

Resets are available with /reset in-game - see the Rules page.

title: First steps
body:
1. Register an account (login name + password + security code).
2. Download the client from the Downloads page.
3. Log in with the same account in the game.
4. If you have questions or problems, contact the server administration.
